subject: Easy stratagy - no cheating
author: Naarkesh
body:
Im gonna do this in steps for you.

  • Get yourself to the West end of Southway Expressway
  • Join a quickmatch. This often results in a clean game with no records set.
  • Burn your way to the top of the dam collecting drift, near miss and oncoming records.
  • Jump down to the quarry collecting airtime, jump distance and barrel roll. You can get flatspin if you send the old favourite Flat Roll (or barrel spin. Whats popular atm?) in to the mix.

That there is something like 7 potentially big records. If you need a another quick one, jump to the bottom of the dam and collect power parking. No one ever sets the power parking record at the start of a game.

I think this is a very legit stratagy. It takes a while for people to realise what you are doing. If you really want to make sure you keep oncoming and drift, do them first and get big ones. They are time consuming to beat.
